AI tools (like Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code or Cursor) connect through greenshot-mcp, which comes with %@. They can list your windows, take screenshots and run your recipes. While this is off, Greenshot refuses every request without asking. Each program still needs your permission the first time it connects.

File names can then use ${url} and ${browser} of the page, and ${Browser.Url}, ${Browser.Domain}, ${Browser.Title}, ${Browser.Ticket} of the browser's active tab (the extension's tab tracking).

column1: Word, PowerPoint and Outlook insert into a new document, presentation or mail, or one that is open (the destination menu lists them). Excel inserts into the active sheet of an open or a new workbook. Outlook attaches the screenshot and uses the Email section's subject, To, CC and BCC; with “allow export in meeting items” it also lists the open meetings you organise and attaches the screenshot to the meeting. New Outlook can't be scripted. OneNote for Mac can't be scripted either: Notes takes its place (or use Open With). On a layout without a picture placeholder the screenshot is centred on the slide; a layout PowerPoint refuses gives a blank slide.
column2: Word, PowerPoint d Outlook ggeren ɣer warrat amaynut, tuddsa neɣ imayl, neɣ wid yeldin (umuɣ n tiniɣriwin yesskan-iten). Excel igger ɣer tebdart tamlellit n ukaru yeldin neɣ amaynut. Outlook yessiweḍ tuṭṭfa n ugdil u yesseqdac azwel, Ɣer, CC d BCC n uḥric Imayl; s “sireg asifeḍ deg yiferdisen n tmeɣra” yesskan daɣen tameɣrin yeldin i tsebbaḍeḍ u yessiweḍ tuṭṭfa ɣer tmeɣra. Outlook amaynut ur yezmir ara ad yettwakkes s script. OneNote i Mac ur yezmir ara daɣen: Notes ad yeddu deg umkan-is (neɣ seqdec Ldi s). Deg tarrayt war amkan n tugna, tuṭṭfa n ugdil tettwasṭerḍ deg tlemmast n tsutin; tarrayt ur yeqbil ara PowerPoint tefk tasutin tilemt.

column2: “Teɣzi n tugna” tgeṛ asebter d aqeṛṛu am tuṭṭfa n ugdil d yiɣezran. Tugna tettwaslemmes ɣef usebter.

column1: “Share screenshots using Dropbox” takes the macOS screenshot keys
column2: “Bḍu tuṭṭfiwin n ugdil s Dropbox” yeṭṭef tisura n tuṭṭfa n ugdil n macOS

column1: ⇧ can't be the only modifier, except for F1–F20.
column2: ⇧ ur izmir ara ad yili d asnifel kan, ala i F1–F20.
